sections.body: Many people help us every day. 💛
Doctors and nurses help us when we are sick. 🩺
Firefighters put out fires and keep us safe. 🚒
Farmers grow the food we eat. 🌾 Teachers help us learn. 📚
Who helped you today? Say thank you to them!
Talk about helpers your child meets: bus drivers, shopkeepers, cleaners, grandparents. If you're comfortable, explain who to go to if they ever get lost (a police officer, or a parent with children).

hints: Think of the big red truck.
This helper sprays water with a hose.
A doctor 🩺 helps sick people. Who helps when there's a fire?

quiz.q: Who grows food like rice, wheat and apples? 🍎
hints: This helper works with plants and animals on a farm.
A teacher works in a school. Who works on a farm?
